question: What ritual topic concerning the installation of knowledge will be explained next?
premises: The preceding discussion is concluded with thus
The subject is the installation related to knowledge and its power
The text announces what will now be spoken
inference: The installation of knowledge, in its power, will now be explained.
uncertainties: The exact analysis of prabhāvasyāt is uncertain in the fused form.
plain_english: Thus, the installation connected with the power of knowledge will now be explained.
